_meta.note: Captured off the wire: `mimo acp` 0.1.15 (npm @mimo-ai/cli, linux-arm64) driven over stdio by a probe client, `MIMOCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT` carrying `permission: ask`. The model was served through a loopback LiteLLM proxy (1.105.1) in front of Amazon Bedrock Claude Haiku 4.5, named to the harness as an openai-compatible provider `probe/probe-model`, so `cost` reads 0. Each MCP server is a stdio probe with one tool `<label>_codeword` that logs every method it serves. A first process ran session/new with one server (alpha) and a turn that called alpha's tool (kiwi-31), then exited. A SECOND process, the one recorded here, sent session/load of that session id with alpha AND beta in mcpServers: the harness replayed the earlier turn, answered with modes and configOptions, and its next turn called beta's tool under the fused title `beta_beta_codeword` (plum-17, after a permission request) and recalled kiwi-31 from the restored history. The servers' own logs show beta started only in the second process. Reductions: session, message and tool-call ids replaced with fixed synthetic values; the probe's working directory written as ~/mimo-proj; the `model` select cut to its current value; available_commands_update dropped; consecutive agent_message_chunk frames of one message folded into one frame. `agentInfo.name` is the harness's own answer: the fork still reports `OpenCode`.
